{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Biden has pushed to include a comprehensive paid leave program in legislation that became the Inflation Reduction Act.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden instructed federal agencies to expand access to paid and unpaid leave for federal employees.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Military Parental Leave Program was expanded so all active-duty, new-parent servicemembers can take 12 weeks of leave.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Biden's budget includes the strongest paid leave proposals in history, permanently funding a national paid leave plan.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"A plan will create America's first, full, national paid family and medical leave program, guaranteeing every American worker up to 12 weeks of paid time off to care for a new child or loved one, to recover from an illness, in cases of domestic violence, or military deployment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The national paid leave plan will help families care for one another.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The national paid leave plan will help businesses retain valuable talent and small businesses to compete.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Millions more parents will be able to work if the plan is implemented.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The plan will add hundreds of billions to the economy.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats have pushed for this paid leave plan for decades.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"When the pandemic crushed supply chains, prices for everyday items, from food to gas to airfare, went up.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"After supply bottlenecks eased, many companies did not lower prices in line with their falling costs.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden will continue to call out companies for price gouging.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"President Biden will hold companies accountable when they do not pass savings on to consumers.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will work to boost supply, fix supply chains and promote competition, especially for essential items like gas and groceries.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Record energy production of clean energy, oil, and gas has lowered prices at the pump for American families.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Administration released nearly 200 million barrels of gasoline from the Strategic Petroleum and Northeast Gasoline Supply reserves.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is lowering gas prices by up to 25 cents per gallon more in certain markets, particularly in the Midwest, by making cheaper, E15 ethanol-blended gasoline available each summer.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Administration is cracking down to prevent collusion by oil companies that could raise prices.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
